findings: Android merge fallback commented but still present — ProductSyncManager.kt lines 148-152 contain commented code for the old merge strategy. Remove entirely to prevent accidental re-enablement.

Dashboard duplicate check runs unconditionally — ProductForm.jsx lines 165-189 fetch products on every create attempt regardless of product name. Cache the check result or debounce the input to avoid unnecessary API calls.

Unique index creation may fail with legacy data — If products.json is imported manually with duplicate (name, category) pairs, the unique index will fail to create. Document the import order: clean database, apply fixes, then import.

Seed script whitespace normalization asymmetry — seedProducts.js line 158 normalizes the product name before checking for duplicates but the Product model does not normalize names on save. Two products with 'Ways 200  Grammes' (double space) and 'Ways 200 Grammes' (single space) could still be inserted if created via dashboard before the backend duplicate check runs.

No migration plan for Android users with cached duplicates — Users who already have 10 tobacco products cached locally will continue seeing duplicates until they clear cache or reinstall. Consider adding a cache version check to force re-sync.
